title: Curriculum-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robust Autonomous Rocket Landing under Atmospheric Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.38636v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous far-range rocket landing is a challenging control problem because navigation, descent-rate regulation, attitude management, and fuel use must be coordinated in the presence of uncertain atmospheric and vehicle dynamics. This paper presents a curriculum-driven proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework for three-dimensional rocket landing in a stochastic environment incorporating altitude-dependent aerodynamic drag, wind shear, temporally correlated turbulence, discrete gusts, uncertain propulsion and aerodynamic parameters, thrust-vector misalignment, engine lag, actuator-gain variation, noisy observations, and command latency. Learning is organised into far-range approach, soft descent, and integrated landing stages. Policy transfer, critic warm-up after reward changes, rehearsal of earlier tasks, and progressive expansion of weather severity are used to support learning across these coupled phases. translated_title: 基于课程学习的深度强化学习实现大气不确定性下鲁棒的自主火箭着陆
translated_abstract: 自主远距离火箭着陆是一个具有挑战性的控制问题，因为需要在不确定的大气和飞行器动力学条件下协调导航、下降速率调节、姿态管理和燃料使用。本文提出了一种课程驱动的近端策略优化（PPO）框架，用于在随机环境中进行三维火箭着陆，该随机环境包含随高度变化的气动阻力、风切变、时间相关湍流、离散阵风、不确定的推进与气动参数、推力矢量偏差、发动机滞后、执行器增益变化、观测噪声以及指令延迟。学习过程被组织为远距离接近、软着陆下降和综合着陆三个阶段，并采用策略迁移、奖励函数变更后的评论家网络预热、先前任务重演以及天气恶劣程度渐进扩展等方法，以支持这些耦合阶段的学习。在10万次评估中……
tldr: 本文提出一种课程驱动的PPO深度强化学习框架，通过分阶段训练、策略迁移和天气恶劣程度渐进扩展等机制，使火箭在风切变、湍流、推进参数不确定性等复杂大气条件下实现鲁棒的自主三维着陆。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a curriculum-driven PPO deep reinforcement learning framework that achieves robust autonomous 3D rocket landing under complex atmospheric uncertainties—such as wind shear, turbulence, and propulsion parameter uncertainty—through staged learning, policy transfer, and progressive expansion of weather severity.
